messages.subject: Re: Problems downloading Distance 7.1

Malene:

This problem was reported a week ago as well. Here is the answer I provided for that person, see if this resolves your problem:

I did a bit of searching on the Internet for the problem you report regarding the installation of Distance 7.1.  It might be the case that you have anti-virus software on your computer that prevents the WinZip self-extractor from permitting you to extract the files from this D7_1Release1.EXE file.

Try to extract those files manually, using something like 7-Zip.  With the files manually extracted, you should then see a file called "setup.exe" in the directory where you performed the extraction.  You should be able to run the "setup.exe" file by double clicking on it, and then Distance 7 should be installed.

The steps I describe are loosely based upon the remedy described here

https://www.zubairalexander.com/blog/how-to-fix-error-0-running-command-setup-exe-when-printing-to-cutepdf-writer/
